provenance: 0.15 pJ/B/hop and 168 kGE router + 28 kGE NI at 512-bit wide data links from https://arxiv.org/pdf/2409.17606v2. Fixed control, NI energy, buffer-depth scaling, and collective arithmetic are estimates.
scope: Router-plus-adjacent-wire lumped per-hop budget; no second wire-energy charge. Wider links change beat count and area, not payload bytes twice. Simulation request queues are not physical flit buffers.
